results.detail: decided report_blocker; no command matches /salmon|kallisto|STAR|hisat2|featureCounts|bowtie/; blocker: Differential expression can't be run: the inputs have no count matrix. The only data files are T1_R1.fastq.gz and T1_R2.fastq.gz, which are 16 bytes each, so they are effectively empty. They cover one sample (T1), and there are no reads for T2, T3, C1, C2 or C3. samples.csv lists 6 samples (3 treated, 3 control; batch 1/2/1 within each group), but it holds only metadata. Read alignment and quantification are outside this environment's scope. To proceed I need a gene-by-sample raw count matrix for all 6 samples (for example from featureCounts, STAR or Salmon). I would then run DESeq2 with the design ~ batch + group.
